$comment: Setup-time model suggestions. Profiles match on host hardware, not on provider ids, because provider ids in platforms.json are runtime-specific (ollama-local, llama-cpp-local, hermes-proxy, sglang-remote, ollama, openai-compatible) while the useful question at setup time is how much VRAM the box has. gpuVramGbMin is compared against a host's hardware.detected.totalGpuVramGb; the highest threshold a host satisfies wins. Model names here are suggestions to pull, not a registry — platforms.json remains the source of truth for what is actually served.

recommendedModels.name: qwen3-coder:30b-a3b-tq2_0
recommendedModels.reason: Strong local coding lane for high-VRAM multi-GPU workstations.

recommendedModels.name: qwq:32b-tq2_0
recommendedModels.reason: Useful local reasoning lane when you want to avoid cloud or remote dependency.
